title: PHP development team plans to release updates tomorrow to address two vulnerabilities, each rated 9.2; security researchers at watchTowr say they are RCE flaws (Lawrence Abrams/BleepingComputer)
summary: Lawrence Abrams / BleepingComputer: PHP development team plans to release updates tomorrow to address two vulnerabilities, each rated 9.2; security researchers at watchTowr say they are RCE flaws — The PHP security team is warning administrators to prepare for emergency security updates tomorrow to address two critical vulnerabilities …
